crossRefs.note: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah Hezron’s wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…

people.name: Azubah
people.line: Wife of Caleb and mother of Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

people.name: Caleb
people.line: Son of Hezron, descendant of Judah

people.name: Ephrathah
people.line: A wife of Caleb and founder of Bethlehem.

people.name: Hur
people.line: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.

translations.web: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
translations.bsb: When Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who bore to him Hur.
translations.kjv: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
translations.asv: And Azubah died, and Caleb took unto him Ephrath, who bare him Hur.
